Mahadev App Kingpin Sourabh Chandrakar Extradited From Oman

Sourabh Chandrakar, described as the kingpin and a promoter of the Mahadev betting app, has been extradited from Oman to India by the CBI. He is scheduled to be produced in a CBI court in Raipur on Monday. Chandrakar had been on the run for years before his extradition.
